text: ‘Cultural differences between people are disappearing as a result of globalisation.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
OR
‘The main factor behind the rise in global crime is Western exploitation of developing societies.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The media is able to shape the way people think and behave.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The new media is controlled by the rich and powerful.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion supports patriarchal values.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Religion has lost its social significance.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
